name: The Yearly Seed (Niên Chủng Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each Fire art you cast refreshes every Wood buff stack on you and adds one more. If you go 10 s without casting Fire in a fight, all your Wood buff stacks flower at once: each heals you once, and then they are all gone.

story: The censer, the bell that stopped ringing and the ring of the seed-picker who bore him. The head holds all three and wears them into the grove every spring. The bell is silent because he has not let the grove flower, and he hopes no one asks why.

name: The Rain Record (Vũ Ký Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Flood Feeds the Garden (Thủy Dưỡng Điền)
bonuses.rule: each second your flood is up, you gain one Wood buff stack, and each fades after 6 s. When the flood ends, each stack heals you for 1 % of your health.

story: The gauge, the terrace fan and the coast oilskin, all of the Water Fields. She holds all three and carries them to Tử Trúc Lâm and back, which the head has not noticed.
